findings.title: Newline labels lose the original multiline layout
findings.problem: Accepted archive/entry/texture strings can contain LF. contactSheets passes each entire caption to single-line shaping; original ImageDraw.text dispatches LF-containing captions to multiline_text with preserved blank lines, default line step and caption color. The new output publishes successfully with different pixels.
findings.minimal_fix: In the existing contactSheets label orchestration preserve original LF line splitting, blank/trailing lines and default vertical placement before invoking the existing whole-line textMasks backend. Carry each caption color explicitly when expanding labels. Do not narrow accepted text by rejecting or removing newlines. Extend existing integration test with complete-page original oracle.
findings.if_skipped: Valid manifest labels produce wrong caption content/placement while command exits successfully.

findings.status: OPEN in immutable reviewed WIP snapshot
findings.title: Painting all thumbnails before all captions changes occlusion
findings.problem: The original _sheet paints thumbnail then both captions for each row before advancing to the next row. The new code paints all page thumbnails then all captions. Whole-page clipping explicitly permits ink outside the cell. Tall Unicode combining marks from an earlier row therefore paint over a later thumbnail that should cover them. This is independent of LF handling.
findings.input: Seven UI rows, archive = A followed by sixteen U+0325 COMBINING RING BELOW characters, no newline; same pinned opaque64x40 PNG filled RGBA(20,30,40,255). Archive uses33 UTF8bytes, well below256bound. Rows have unique entry ordinals0..6; UI intentionally retains duplicates.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep existing page-level shaping if useful, but composite in source draw order: each row thumbnail, first caption, second caption, then next row. Reuse pixelOver and existing loops; no new renderer/helper needed. Extend existing page test with the seven-row control pair.
findings.if_skipped: Valid labels can paint over and misrepresent later preview artwork; fixing only multiline dispatch leaves this mismatch.
